question: As per 2011 census, which Indian state has the lowest literacy rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the **2011 census, Bihar** has the** lowest literacy rate **in India.
 
• The literacy rate in Bihar according to the **2011 census** is** 63.82%**.
 
• **Literacy rate** refers to the percentage of people who can** read and write** in a particular state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharashtra** has a literacy rate of** 82.34%** according to the 2011 census.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** has a literacy rate of **69.72% **according to the 2011 census.
 
• **Jharkhand** has a literacy rate of **66.41%** according to the 2011 census.
